text.en:
The provisions of Commonwealth Act Numbered Six hundred and six, as amended by Republic
Act Numbered Nine hundred and thirteen; the Code of Commerce, particularly Articles 580 and 584 thereof;
and all other Acts, executive orders and regulations inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly."
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 16th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
